what: Seven per-checkout slots (`plans`, `fronts`, `outputs`, `sized`, `answers`, `walked`, `stills`) each hold `the last one`, each with its own rule for when it is dropped; making one of them keyed (`plans`) meant reading every site of the other six to see which assumed the last plan was the only plan.
cost: most of the reading for the plan store; `answers`, `sized`, `outputs` left single because their validity rules could not be changed blind
cause: each slot was added for one sequence (no-op build, edit, edit) and `the last` was the cheapest key
whys: a checkout was assumed to have one request shape at a time
prevention: proposed: one `Kept<K, V>` store type in serve (keyed, bounded by footprint, least recently used let go) that every per-checkout slot uses, and a lint row banning `Vec<Option<_>>` slots in `Roots`
fix: plans written in this lane; the rest not done
